# Pending ASCII primes and following scripts

The parent is independently accepted D053 merge `7c6a5cf0ec1aaa7a5dcab78c3d68c8720c1c5abc`. Generators hash-check the unchanged D2 v0.8.1 MathJax 3.2.2 assets (source commit `ad8f5c21cb810236551da8c6512ba733e67357ee`). No primary parser or renderer patches are used.

`generate_prime_attachment.cjs` regenerates all 96 original discovery cases. Ninety-two have raw whole-SVG and explicit kind/text/attribute/child equality. All twenty required primary errors are preserved. Of those 92 cases, 24 have raw own-property equality and 68 retain only the existing missing `pseudoscript` property, explicitly bound by node path, primary value and prime text. This inherited operator behavior is outside the parser change; no broad property exclusion is used.

The four U+2019/mixed-prime cases remain the separate D061 dispatch/collector boundary. Their SVG bytes remain identical to the accepted parent. Pure U+2019 trees are unchanged. In mixed cases only the ASCII prime token gets the corrected variantForm property instead of an explicit variantForm attribute and an extra texClass property; the unhandled Unicode character remains unchanged. Exact complete expected trees and accepted-parent tree hashes bind that distinction.

`generate_prime_lifetime.cjs` supplies 66 additional raw SVG/explicit-tree controls for comments, no-op commands, groups, visible items, style/color/size boundaries, nested scripts and font declaration lifetime. A broader 64-case exploratory lifetime capture is retained in the review evidence: four primary runtime crashes reproduce without instrumentation; two empty-label SVG differences, two unsupported relax-command cases and two existing choose-rendering cases are separately reported rather than asserted as parity. None is concealed by this successful-control fixture.

`internal/tex/testdata/generate_pending_prime.cjs` directly invokes the actual registered Prime, Subscript, Superscript, PrimeItem and SubsupItem implementations for 162 combinations. Tests compare required errors, original base/token identity, wrapper reuse, every explicit attribute/own property, ordered children and parent ownership. For consumed scripts only, the existing D053 compact-family projection bridges the source's generic families and Go's compact kinds; the raw primary fixture is retained unchanged. PrimeItem finalization preserves authored subtype kind and original identity. Parser-owned eager families are covered separately by the existing D053/D056 controls and public trees.

Pending state belongs to one parseRow call and never becomes a public property or cloned pair. A following script consumes the original base and prime token; superscripts get the source's explicit prime-plus-argument mrow. Finalization on an ordinary item or group boundary reuses a generic side-script slot or wraps the original base. Explicit limits while primes remain pending still reject. ASCII counting is unchanged; initial/mixed Unicode dispatch is not modified.

Coupled annotation and explicit-Limits tests remove only obsolete prime expectations. All 48 annotation, 50 stack-placement, 72 stackrel and 98 limits SVGs remain strict against the unchanged primary fixtures, with the precise inherited brace/prime metadata receipts documented in their own files.

Independent source-edge review records the visible relax no-op, choose fence and shadowed binom behavior as separate D062, D063 and D064 findings. Their fixes are excluded from D060. The empty tag-descendant difference is not a visible finding.
